meta.title: AIlingo

landing.lead: Learn to use AI in marketing and everyday work through short games. No AI behind the scenes, with clear grading rules.
landing.f1: Build a prompt, spot a hallucination, fix a weak prompt and seven more game types.
landing.f2: An AI track (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, MCP, Claude Code, Codex) and a Marketing track.
landing.f3: Deterministic rules and checklists, no black box.
landing.f4: Mistakes come back when it's time to review them (SM-2).
landing.free: 10 minutes of learning free every day. Premium for unlimited.
